alt: Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot standing in an industrial promotional setting with Hyundai branding, the white and black bipedal robot looking both impressive and faintly ominous next to a Hyundai vehicle
story: Hyundai deployed Boston Dynamics' Atlas robots to deliver the match ball at the FIFA World Cup on July 5 as a PR stunt, then 39,000 Hyundai factory workers launched the first-ever humanoid robot factory strike on July 13, demanding a say before Atlas enters their plants.
why_funny: The same company that paid millions to showcase its human-replacement robots at the world's biggest sporting event triggered the first worker rebellion against those exact robots within two weeks.
